meta.title: 그림자 토끼전
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (그림자 토끼전, a children's shadow play of the old tale of the rabbit and the turtle (fictional company)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 그림자 토끼전, a children's shadow play of the old tale of the rabbit and the turtle (fictional company)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Lamplight through cloth: a screen that glows from cream #FFE2A8 at the lamp to burnt orange and deep brown at its edges, flickering; shadows a warm dark brown #24150E, never black; dyed holes in the leather in red #D9503A, green #5FA35A, blue #3F7FC4, gold #F2B640 and pink; a dark wooden proscenium with red curtains.
rationale.type: Song Myung, a brushed serif, cut through the hanging boards so the lamp shows through the letters; Gowun Batang for the subtitles under the stage.
rationale.motion: Puppet motion: jointed parts turning on pivots (ears, flippers, a sleeve), hops on the beat in arcs, a turtle that swims and stretches its neck, boards that drop in on strings and sway, the moon lowered on its rod; a puppet lifted off the screen is soft and large until it is pressed to the cloth; the lamp flickers all the time.
rationale.sound: Folk at 96 BPM in D major on a pentatonic scale (0 2 4 7 9) with recorded instruments (VCSL and VSCO 2 CE, CC0): a bowed psaltery bed like a haegeum, a plucked zither (dan tranh) like a gayageum, a flute hook like a daegeum, an upright bass, kick and shaker; a gong (jing) opens and closes the play, a frame drum (buk) marks the hops.
rationale.visuals: All code: each puppet is drawn into its own buffer as a silhouette, its carved holes cut out (destination-out) so the screen shows through, translucent dye laid into some; rods run down past the stage edge; the screen is a radial lamp gradient with a woven texture multiplied in.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the subtitles tell the tale.
